question: How many high-priority maintenance tickets are currently open?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maintenance_tickets WHERE status = 'open' AND priority = 'high'

question: Which parts are below their reorder point at the Houston plant?
expected_sql: SELECT part_id FROM inventory WHERE plant_id = 'HOU' AND on_hand < reorder_point ORDER BY 1

question: Which equipment model has the most unplanned downtime events this year?
expected_sql: SELECT m.model FROM downtime_events d JOIN machines m USING(machine_id) WHERE d.reason_code IN ('MECH','ELEC') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which suppliers are below the on-time delivery requirement in our supplier quality agreement?
expected_sql: SELECT s.name FROM purchase_orders p JOIN suppliers s USING(supplier_id) WHERE p.received_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.supplier_id HAVING AVG(p.received_date <= p.promised_date) < 0.95 ORDER BY 1

question: Are any critical spares below their reorder point at any plant? List plant and part.

question: Are we meeting the preventive maintenance target for share of downtime? What is our actual PM share?
